action_notes.charge: circulate collector loop through the store (pump on, flow in [pump_flow_min, pump_flow_max])
action_notes.discharge: draw store -> load at delivery temp; collector loop off or idle
action_notes.bypass: collector loop bypasses the store (pump off / diverter) — the overheat-protection action

control_skeleton.recommended_action_space: continuous-flow hybrid (mode in {charge, discharge, bypass} + continuous flow_rate_kg_s within flow_envelope_kg_s) — the pump range (0.010-0.050 kg/s) is continuous, so a discrete-only action space would discard usable control resolution
control_skeleton.hard_rule: the controller must never command a flow or temperature outside this regime's flow_envelope_kg_s / max_water_temp_C / max_pcm_temp_C — the safety shield below overrides the policy if it tries
control_skeleton.observation_notes: The tank is stratified: delivery temperature is the TOP node, the collector inlet is the BOTTOM node. recoverable_energy_above_45C_kWh is the WP1 E_rec,45 quantity and needs an estimator (not a raw sensor). Loop flow sets stratification, not collector heat, in this model.

safety_shield.force_bypass_if: T_water_top_C >= 72.0 (3.0 C guard band below the 75.0 C hard limit, to allow for sensor and control lag)
safety_shield.dry_run: pump commanded on, flow sensor reads ~0 -> stop pump, raise fault
safety_shield.sensor_failure: missing reading for a required field -> fall back to bypass (safe default), raise fault
safety_shield.rationale: Hard requirement carried from the earlier contract. In the current model the shield acts on the TOP water node (start of sub-step) and on the PCM; plain-tank peaks reached 73.3 C in the multi-node model, below the 75 C limit (docs/PROGRESS.md section 6).
safety_shield.note_v2: Finding: the existing PCM-side shield only blocks CHARGING at 62 C and is not enough for PCMs already above their melt band; some designs exceed 65 C. A design is infeasible if its PCM peak exceeds 65 C in any simulated year.

dynamic_state_schema.description: One observation per control timestep. Fields marked measurable=false need an estimator (energy-balance + calibrated melt-fraction observer), not a raw sensor. T_pcm_C and f_melt are degenerate for the plain-tank regimes (no PCM) but kept in the vector for a state-invariant contract across future PCM-bearing states.

reward_function.status: suggested (v2), weights NOT chosen: built from the WP1 metrics; Objective 3 sets and justifies weights
reward_function.formula: r_t = w1 * E_del45_t - w2 * overheat_step_t - w3 * safety_violation_t - w4 * bypass_switch_t, with E_del45_t the energy delivered up to 45 C in the step (night and morning steps may be weighted more, WP1 window 18:00-09:00)
reward_function.removed_terms: the earlier pump-energy term is removed: pump energy is not meaningful in the O2 model (Ergun pressure drop across the capsule bed only). The earlier normalisation constants and default weights came from the retired Phase-7 designs and are removed, not carried over.
reward_function.normalisation: to be computed by Objective 3 from the water-only twin of the chosen design over the explore years

penalty_term_definitions.safety_violation_t: 1 if the TOP water node is at or above 72 C or the PCM is at or above 62 C (the shield guard band), else 0
penalty_term_definitions.bypass_switch_t: 1 if the mode changes into bypass at this step, else 0
penalty_term_definitions.overheat_step_t: shield-active time in the step (the quantity behind d_overheat)
